attempts.summary: Deployed a simple inventory web application (httpd + CGI, returning JSON inventory data tagged with the serving host) on node2 and node3, each listening on port 8080. Configured node1 with Apache httpd mod_proxy_balancer as an HTTP reverse-proxy load balancer on port 80, distributing requests byrequests across the two backends. Verified round-robin distribution and failover behavior, then completed the mandatory sequential restart-evidence protocol on all three nodes: baseline captured, one node restarted at a time via `shutdown -r now`, changed boot_id confirmed on each, and service/load-balancer recovery verified after each restart, with the LB correctly failing over to the surviving backend while node2 or node3 was down.
